description: Renovate only bumps the go directive in go.mod, keeping it on the latest Go release like beenfar's.

packageRules.description: Module dependencies are not managed by Renovate.

Track the latest Go release at x.y.0, as beenfar does: the provider imports beenfar's api module, whose go directive follows the latest release, so it cannot require an older Go. Patch releases are not required, so patch-only bumps are not proposed.
